name: hukuhaka-report-planner
description: Plan evidence-based visual documents as content specifications, then delegate representation, design, construction, and visual verification to a dedicated artifact designer.

interface.longDescription: Research source material and finalize content requirements in spec.md. For artifact requests, one designer selects visual representations, authors design.md, builds, and verifies the result.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan the content of this visual document and, when the artifact is requested, delegate its design and construction from the finalized content specification.
